title: Crispy German Yautia Bowl
description: A hearty German-inspired bowl filled with crispy yautia, peppery flavors, and a touch of Algerian spice.
instructions: Peel and cut the yautia into 1-inch pieces.
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, water, peppercorns, and Algerian spice blend.
Add the yautia pieces to the bowl and toss to coat.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the yautia pieces in batches until crispy and golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Drain the yautia on paper towels and season with salt to taste.
Serve the crispy yautia in a bowl and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
